correctness.rationale: Reconstructed section vertices as crossed edges and exact deficit 2(d+1)t(1-t)/d. Near-unit radii correspond to belts |<U,v_i>|<=k times an opposite-signed height; first-order spherical belt density and Gaussian range yield C_d=sqrt(d(d+1))/(sqrt(2pi))*E max_{j<=d} Z_j. Distinct vertex-belt overlaps are O(k^2) for d>=3 (disjoint in planar small-k regime). Exact planar belt angle yields F_2(0)=0,F_2(1/2)=1/2,F_2(2/3)=1, and the stated small-epsilon coefficient; independent high-precision planar evaluations checked. Standard iid minimum order statistic proves exponential limit and expected deficit asymptotic. No uniformity in growing d asserted.
